heading: UTP Cable
bottomHtml: UTP Cable (Unshielded Twisted Pair) is a versatile and cost-effective networking solution used for both commercial and residential applications. Designed to provide high-performance data transmission, it supports Ethernet networks, LAN connections, and multimedia systems. UTP cables are available in various categories, including Cat5e, Cat6, and Cat6a, offering scalable options for a range of network speeds. With easy installation and reliable performance, UTP cables are essential for building strong, efficient, and fast communication infrastructures
